vocab.sentence: Gary is depressed about his failure to win the road race.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Gary 因為沒能贏得路跑比賽而感到沮喪。

vocab.sentence: This writer is famous for his amusing Facebook posts, and they always make the readers laugh.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位作家以他有趣的 Facebook 貼文聞名，這些貼文總是逗得讀者發笑。

vocab.sentence: Mia gathered her colored pencils and put them into her pencil case.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Mia 收起她的彩色鉛筆，把它們放進鉛筆盒裡。

vocab.sentence: Mr. Huang donates money to an organization every month to help poor children.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 黃先生每個月都捐錢給一個機構，幫助貧困的孩子。

vocab.sentence: Anna is doing research on new ways to bake a cake.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Anna 正在研究烤蛋糕的新方法。

vocab.sentence: The young artist was excited to display her works at a famous arts festival.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位年輕藝術家很興奮能在一個知名藝術節展示她的作品。

vocab.sentence: To become a better cook, Julie insisted on practicing her knife skills every day.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 為了成為更好的廚師，Julie 堅持每天練習刀工。

vocab.sentence: After months of hard work, Daniel achieved his goal of getting one hundred thousand fans on YouTube.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 經過數個月的努力，Daniel 達成了在 YouTube 上擁有十萬名粉絲的目標。

vocab.sentence: I didn't eat much for lunch, so I feel particularly hungry now.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我午餐吃得不多，所以現在覺得特別餓。

vocab.sentence: Rebecca puts the frozen meat in warm water, so she can cook it for lunch later.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Rebecca 把冷凍肉放進溫水裡，這樣待會就能把它煮來當午餐。

vocab.sentence: The color green is a mix of blue and yellow.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 綠色是藍色和黃色的混合。

vocab.sentence: Gary loves the strong flavor of blue cheese.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Gary 喜歡藍紋起司的濃郁味道。

vocab.sentence: Ariel is so busy that she hasn't visited her parents for a long period of time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Ariel 忙得已經很長一段時間沒去探望父母了。

vocab.sentence: The ding-dong sound from Mandy's smartphone represents an incoming LINE message.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Mandy 的智慧型手機發出叮咚聲，表示有一則 LINE 訊息傳進來。

vocab.sentence: We had an enjoyable picnic with delicious food and music.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們享受了一次有美食和音樂的愉快野餐。

vocab.sentence: Tom is willing to do anything to promote his new product.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Tom 願意做任何事來推廣他的新產品。

vocab.sentence: My grandparents are glad to embrace new technology although it takes time to learn.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我的祖父母很樂意接受新科技，雖然學習需要花時間。

vocab.sentence: I walk down a path between the two houses to get to my school every day.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我每天沿著兩棟房屋之間的小徑走去學校。

phrases.sentence: Judy and Roy have a lot in common. For example, they both love sushi and ramen.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Judy 和 Roy 有很多共通點，例如他們都喜歡壽司和拉麵。

phrases.sentence: We had a problem with our science project, but Alisa came up with a smart solution.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們的科學專題遇到了問題，但 Alisa 想出了一個聰明的解決辦法。

phrases.sentence: Tyler was tired of his room, so he decided to redecorate it.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Tyler 厭倦了自己的房間，因此決定重新裝潢。

phrases.sentence: The delay in the building project was due to the snowstorm.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 這項建築工程因暴風雪而延誤。

phrases.sentence: Nowadays, an MP3 player is thought to be behind the times.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 如今，MP3 播放器被認為已經過時了。

phrases.sentence: The restaurant went out of business because fewer and fewer customers chose to eat there.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 這家餐廳歇業了，因為選擇去那裡用餐的顧客越來越少。

tips.label: 限定三者
tips.text: 三個對象依序介紹：One... Another... The other...；the other 指最後剩下的一個。

tips.label: 限定兩者
tips.text: 只有兩個時：One... The other...，例如 One is new, and the other is old.

tips.label: 接單數名詞
tips.text: one、another、the other 都可代替單數名詞，也可接單數名詞：one path、another path、the other path。

tips.label: 間接問句語序
tips.text: 疑問詞後面用直述句語序：wh- + 主詞 + 動詞；有 can、should、will 等助動詞時，放在主詞後面。

tips.label: do／does／did
tips.text: 用來形成一般問句的 do／does／did 通常拿掉，動詞恢復相應的現在式或過去式；否定的 don’t／doesn’t／didn’t 要保留。

tips.label: who 作主詞
tips.text: who 本身是做動作的人時，直接接動詞：I wonder who opened the door. 不要再補一個 he 或 she。

notes.title: 限定三個：one、another、the other
notes.description: 在已知的三個對象中，one 引出一個，another 引出另一個，the other 指最後剩下的那一個。本課用這個句型依序介紹三個單數對象。other 單獨不能在此代替單數可數名詞；others 和 the others 是複數，不能代替最後唯一的一個。
examples: We have three boxes. One is red, another is blue, and the other is green.（我們有三個箱子。一個是紅色，另一個是藍色，最後一個是綠色。）
There are three plans. One is useful, another is simple, and the other is amusing.（有三個計畫。一個實用，另一個簡單，最後一個很有趣。）

notes.title: 代名詞、接名詞與單數動詞
notes.rule: one / another / the other + 單數可數名詞
notes.description: 這三個詞可以自己代替已提過的單數名詞，也能接單數名詞，如 another student。another 要寫成一個字，不寫 an other，也不加 an 變成 an another。表示一個人或物時，要配合單數動詞，如 is、has、represents。
examples: One student reads, another student writes, and the other student listens.（一名學生閱讀，另一名學生寫字，最後一名學生聆聽。）
One reads, another writes, and the other listens.（一個人閱讀，另一個人寫字，最後一個人聆聽。）

notes.title: 只有兩個時怎麼說
notes.description: 範圍只有兩個時，介紹完第一個，剩下的就是唯一的另一個，所以用 the other。先找題目中的 two 或 three，再判斷目前還剩幾個；不要看到「另一個」就一律選 another。
examples: There are two paths. One is short, and the other is long.（有兩條小徑。一條短，另一條長。）
I have two phones. One works, but the other is broken.（我有兩支手機。一支能用，另一支壞了。）

notes.title: 間接問句：疑問詞後不倒裝
notes.rule: 主要子句 + wh- + 主詞 +（助動詞）+ 動詞
notes.description: 把疑問句放進 know、wonder、ask、tell 等表達裡時，疑問詞後面改用直述句語序。be 動詞放在主詞後面；can、should、will、would 也放在主詞後面。which country、how many books 等疑問片語要整組保留。
examples: Where is the display? → Do you know where the display is?（你知道展示品在哪裡嗎？）
When should we gather? → Please tell me when we should gather.（請告訴我我們應該何時集合。）
Which flavor do you want? → Tell me which flavor you want.（告訴我你想要哪一種口味。）

notes.title: 一般疑問助動詞 do、does、did 的處理
notes.rule: wh- + 主詞 + 依主詞和時態變化的動詞
notes.description: 普通肯定的間接問句不保留只用來形成問句的 do／does／did。原句有 does 時，動詞要配合第三人稱單數加 s／es；原句有 did 時，主要動詞恢復過去式。原句有 do 時，依複數主詞等情況使用原形動詞。這是普通用法；不要把特殊強調語氣當成這裡的一般改寫。
examples: Where does this path go? → I wonder where this path goes.（我想知道這條小徑通往哪裡。）
What do they have in common? → Tell me what they have in common.（告訴我他們有什麼共通點。）
Why did the shop close? → Do you know why the shop closed?（你知道那家店為什麼關門嗎？）

notes.title: 否定助動詞必須保留
notes.rule: wh- + 主詞 + don’t / doesn’t / didn’t + 原形動詞
notes.description: 否定助動詞包含「不／沒有」的意思，不能套用上一條而直接刪掉。它放在主詞後，主要動詞用原形。be 動詞的否定式也放在主詞後，如 why he wasn’t ready。
examples: Why didn’t Joe come? → Tell me why Joe didn’t come.（告訴我 Joe 為什麼沒來。）
Why doesn’t this machine work? → I wonder why this machine doesn’t work.（我想知道這台機器為什麼不能運作。）
Why wasn’t he willing to help? → Do you know why he wasn’t willing to help?（你知道他為什麼不願意幫忙嗎？）

notes.title: who 本身是主詞，還是子句裡另有主詞
notes.rule: who + 動詞；或 who + 已有的主詞 + 動詞
notes.description: 先找誰在做動作。I wonder who made the video. 中，who 就是製作影片的人，後面直接接 made。Do you know who the woman is? 中，主詞是 the woman，is 放在它後面。whose pencil 中的 whose 表示「誰的」，要和 pencil 放在一起；若借筆的人是 Lisa，則說 whose pencil Lisa borrowed。
examples: Who opened the door? → I wonder who opened the door.（我想知道誰開了門。）
Who is the woman? → Do you know who the woman is?（你知道那位女士是誰嗎？）
Whose pencil did Lisa borrow? → Tell me whose pencil Lisa borrowed.（告訴我 Lisa 借了誰的鉛筆。）

notes.title: 整句標點與介系詞後的間接問句
notes.rule: 問號看主要子句；about 後也可接 wh- 子句
notes.description: Do you know...? 和 Could you tell me...? 整句在提問，所以用問號。I wonder... 是陳述句，Please tell me... 是請求，通常用句號。be curious about 後也能放間接問句，語序仍是疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞。改寫時保留題目提供的時間關係，不要看見間接問句就任意更換時態。
examples: Do you know where the museum is?（你知道博物館在哪裡嗎？）
I wonder where the museum is.（我想知道博物館在哪裡。）
She is curious about why the picnic was so enjoyable.（她很好奇那次野餐為什麼那麼愉快。）

quiz.question: There are exactly three paths to the museum. One is short, another is wide, and ___ is narrow.
quiz.hint: three paths 限定三條，前面已說完一條和另一條，空格指最後一條，用 the other。other 不能單獨代替此處的單數名詞；others／the others 是複數，不能配合 is。

quiz.question: The museum has three rooms. One displays old phones. ___ displays toys. The other displays photos.
quiz.hint: 第一個房間已用 One，最後一個已用 The other，中間用單數代名詞 Another。Other 不能單獨代替一個房間；Others 是複數；another 不拆成 an other。

quiz.question: This frozen yogurt comes in three flavors. ___ flavor is lemon, another is mango, and the other is peach.
quiz.hint: 空格後已有單數名詞 flavor，第一個口味用 One flavor。Ones、Others、The others 都不能這樣直接修飾單數 flavor。

quiz.question: I have three goals this year. One goal is to read more. ___ goal is to exercise. The other goal is to learn to cook.
quiz.hint: 這裡介紹三個目標中的另一個，且後接單數 goal，用 Another。Other 缺少適當限定詞，Others 不能直接接 goal，another 前也不能再加 an。

quiz.question: The school day has three study periods. One is for reading, another is for research, and ___ period is for art.
quiz.hint: 三段學習時間已介紹兩段，最後一段用 the other period。others 和 the others 本身是複數代名詞，不能直接接單數 period；other 單獨接單數可數名詞也不合此處用法。

quiz.question: The organization has only two offices. One is open today, but ___ is closed.
quiz.hint: only two offices 表示只有兩間。說完 One，另一間就是唯一剩下的一間，用 the other；複數 others／the others 不能配合 is。

quiz.question: We found three notes about the failure. ___ is on the desk, another is in a bag, and the other is under a book.
quiz.hint: 後面已有 another 和 the other，這裡用 One 引出三張紙條中的第一張。紙條是一張，動詞是 is，不能用複數 Ones、Others 或 The others。

quiz.question: Three organizations joined the event. One organization brought food. ___ organization brought books. The other brought toys.
quiz.hint: organization 是單數可數名詞，中間另一個組織用 Another organization。Others 不能接名詞；another 是一個字；Other 單獨接此單數名詞缺少限定詞。

quiz.question: Three bags are on display now. One is red. Another ___ blue. The other is green.
quiz.hint: Another 在這裡代替 one bag，表示一個袋子，現在式 be 動詞用 is。前面總共有三個袋子，不代表 Another 是複數。

quiz.question: The three signs show different ideas. One represents hope, another represents love, and the other ___ peace.
quiz.hint: the other 指三個標誌中最後一個，是第三人稱單數主詞。與前面 represents 保持現在式，空格也用 represents。

quiz.question: We came up with three plans. One is cheap. ___ is easy to follow. The other needs more time.
quiz.hint: One 和 The other 分別介紹第一個及最後一個計畫，中間另一個用 Another。空格代替單數 plan，不能用複數 Others，也不能寫成 An other。

quiz.question: There are three boxes in the kitchen. One holds frozen meat, another holds fruit, and ___ holds bread.
quiz.hint: 三個箱子已列出兩個，剩下最後一個用 the other。動詞 holds 也顯示主詞是單數；others／the others 是複數。

quiz.question: I own only two phones. One still works well, but ___ is broken and behind the times.
quiz.hint: only two phones 限定兩支手機，說完 One，唯一的另一支用 the other。Other 不能單獨代替這支手機，others／the others 則是複數。

quiz.question: The class made three amusing videos. ___ video is about a cat, another is about a dog, and the other is about a bird.
quiz.hint: 第一部影片用 One video；video 是單數名詞。Ones、Others、The others 不能像限定詞一樣直接接單數 video。

quiz.question: Three people are preparing the picnic. One cooks, ___ prepares the drinks, and the other washes the fruit.
quiz.hint: 三個人各做一件事，One 之後用 another 引出另一人，the other 指最後一人。another 是單數，能配合 prepares；others 是複數。

quiz.question: All three models are on display now. One works well, another makes noise, and the other ___ broken.
quiz.hint: the other 指最後一個模型，所以雖然總共有 three models，這個子句的主詞仍是單數，be 動詞用 is。

quiz.question: There are three paths outside. ___ leads to the river, another leads to the park, and the other leads to the museum.
quiz.hint: one 作限定詞時接單數可數名詞，因此用 One path。不能把 path 加 s，也不能把限定詞 one 改成 ones。

quiz.question: We visited three museums. One museum was about toys. ___ museum was about failure. The other was about art.
quiz.hint: 三間博物館中的另一間用 Another museum；museum 是單數。Other 單獨接此名詞缺少限定詞，Others 不能接名詞，another 前面不能再加 an。

quiz.question: Could you tell me where ___?
quiz.hint: Could you tell me 後接間接問句，where 後用「主詞 the new display + be 動詞 is」，不能沿用 where is... 的直接問句語序。

quiz.question: I wonder why ___ still frozen.
quiz.hint: why 引導間接問句，主詞 the meat 放在 is 前面。frozen 在這裡是形容詞，需要 be 動詞，不能用 does 代替 is。

quiz.question: Mia wants to know where ___ gather more information for her research.
quiz.hint: where 後用主詞 she + 情態助動詞 can。間接問句不寫 can she，can 前面也不需要 does。

quiz.question: Please tell me what ___ to reach our goal.
quiz.hint: what 後的間接問句用「主詞 we + should + 原形動詞 do」。should 不移到主詞前，do 也不能放到 should 前面。

quiz.question: Do you know when ___ tomorrow?
quiz.hint: when 後要用直述句語序：the museum + will + open。雖然整句以 Do you know 提問，內部子句仍不能把 will 放到主詞前。

quiz.question: I wonder how ___ this new mix of colors.
quiz.hint: how 引導的間接問句用 we can display。主詞在 can 前，原形動詞 display 在 can 後，不能另外加入疑問助動詞 do。

quiz.question: I wonder where this path ___.
quiz.hint: 直接問句是 Where does this path go? 改成間接問句後，疑問助動詞 does 拿掉，this path 是第三人稱單數，因此動詞恢復 goes。

quiz.question: Can you tell me what this picture ___?
quiz.hint: 原本問 What does this picture represent? 間接問句不保留一般疑問用的 does，主詞 this picture 是單數，所以用 represents。

quiz.question: Do you know why ___ on practicing every day?
quiz.hint: why 後面使用主詞 they + 動詞 insist。直接問句的 do 不保留；them 是受格，不能在這裡當主詞。

quiz.question: I wonder why the restaurant ___ out of business last month.
quiz.hint: last month 指過去時間。直接問句 Why did the restaurant go...? 改成間接問句後，拿掉 did，go 恢復過去式 went。

quiz.question: Do you remember where ___ last night?
quiz.hint: where 後用主詞 the group + 過去式 gathered；last night 要求過去時間。不能保留 did the group gather 的問句倒裝。

quiz.question: Please tell me what ___ from the failure yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，間接問句要用 you learned。did you learn 是直接問句語序；去掉 did 後不能仍用一般現在式 learn。

quiz.question: Does Ben know what ___ for the organization right now?
quiz.hint: right now 配合現在進行式。what 後用 we are doing，主詞 we 放在 are 前；外面的 Does Ben know 不會讓內部子句倒裝。

quiz.question: Amy wants to know what ___ at seven last night.
quiz.hint: what 引導間接問句，過去進行式的順序是 her dad + was + cooking。不能把 was 放到主詞 her dad 前面。

quiz.question: I wonder why Leo ___ willing to help. He says he is too busy.
quiz.hint: willing 是形容詞，要配合 be 動詞。Leo 表示他太忙而不願幫忙，子句用 Leo isn’t willing；doesn’t 不能直接接 willing。

quiz.question: Tell me why Anna ___ her goal last week.
quiz.hint: last week 表示過去；didn’t 有否定意思，改為間接問句時要保留。didn’t 後接原形 reach，不能再用 reached 或 reaching。

quiz.question: Do you know why ___ ready to display his work yesterday?
quiz.hint: ready 是形容詞，過去的否定式用 wasn’t。why 後是間接問句，所以主詞 he 放在 wasn’t 前，不能用 wasn’t he 倒裝。

quiz.question: Do you know who ___ the amusing video yesterday?
quiz.hint: who 本身就是製作影片的人，直接作主詞，後接動詞。yesterday 是過去時間，所以用 made；不再補一般疑問助動詞，也不能寫 did made。

quiz.question: Someone has the only key to the display room. Please tell me who ___ it.
quiz.hint: who 代表拿著鑰匙的那個人，本身是主詞；前句 Someone has 提示單數，所以用 has。does has 不正確，having 也不能單獨作此處的限定動詞。

quiz.question: The woman by the display looks familiar. Do you know who ___?
quiz.hint: 這裡詢問那位女士的身分，子句已經有主詞 the woman，who 後接 the woman is。不能沿用 Who is the woman? 的直接問句語序。

quiz.question: I wonder who ___ at the enjoyable picnic yesterday.
quiz.hint: who 是介系詞 with 的受詞，表示 Tom 和誰在一起。子句主詞是 Tom，順序為 Tom was with，不能把 was 提到 Tom 前。

quiz.question: Do you know whose pencil ___ to finish the drawing yesterday?
quiz.hint: whose pencil 是完整疑問片語，Lisa 才是使用鉛筆的人。後接 Lisa used；yesterday 表示過去，不能用 Lisa use，也不能保留 did Lisa use 的倒裝。

quiz.question: Tell me which flavor ___ for your frozen yogurt.
quiz.hint: which flavor 要整組保留，後面接主詞 you + 動詞 want。直接問句中的 do 拿掉，不能寫 do you want。

quiz.question: Some organizations help children after school. Do you know which organizations ___ them?
quiz.hint: which organizations 本身就是幫助孩子的主詞，organizations 是複數，現在式用 help。這裡不用再加另一個主詞，也不能用單數 helps／does。

quiz.question: Do you remember how many books ___ for the research yesterday?
quiz.hint: how many books 是完整疑問片語，後面用 we borrowed。yesterday 表示過去；不保留 did we borrow 的直接問句語序。

quiz.question: Please tell me how long the enjoyable picnic ___ yesterday.
quiz.hint: 直接問句是 How long did the picnic last? 改成間接問句後，拿掉 did，且 yesterday 指過去，主要動詞恢復 lasted。

quiz.question: The teacher is curious about why ___ so early yesterday.
quiz.hint: about 後的 why 子句也用直述語序。the shop 是主詞，yesterday 表示過去，所以後接 closed；不能使用 did the shop close 的倒裝。

quiz.question: Can you tell me why the twins ___ this flavor? They both say it tastes bad.
quiz.hint: the twins 是複數，且後句說兩人都覺得味道不好，所以用否定的 don’t like。否定助動詞保留在主詞後，like 用原形，不加 s。

quiz.question: She wonders how ___ money every month.
quiz.hint: 原本是 How does the organization raise money? 間接問句拿掉一般疑問用的 does，單數主詞 the organization 後的動詞改為 raises。

quiz.question: We wanted to know when ___ the new display.
quiz.hint: when 引導間接問句，順序是主詞 we + 情態助動詞 would + 原形動詞 see。不能沿用 would we see 的問句倒裝。

quiz.question: I wonder why our grandparents ___ new technology so quickly.
quiz.hint: 直接問句 Why do our grandparents embrace...? 改成間接問句後不保留一般疑問用的 do。our grandparents 是複數，所以動詞用 embrace，不加 s。

quiz.question: Please tell me how ___ blue and yellow to make green.
quiz.hint: how 後要用主詞 I + should + 原形動詞 mix。間接問句不把 should 放到 I 前，也不另外加 do。

vocab.sentence: Gary is depressed about his failure to win the road race.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Gary 因為沒能贏得路跑比賽而感到沮喪。

vocab.sentence: This writer is famous for his amusing Facebook posts, and they always make the readers laugh.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位作家以他有趣的 Facebook 貼文聞名，這些貼文總是逗得讀者發笑。

vocab.sentence: Mia gathered her colored pencils and put them into her pencil case.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Mia 收起她的彩色鉛筆，把它們放進鉛筆盒裡。

vocab.sentence: Mr. Huang donates money to an organization every month to help poor children.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 黃先生每個月都捐錢給一個機構，幫助貧困的孩子。

vocab.sentence: Anna is doing research on new ways to bake a cake.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Anna 正在研究烤蛋糕的新方法。

vocab.sentence: The young artist was excited to display her works at a famous arts festival.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位年輕藝術家很興奮能在一個知名藝術節展示她的作品。

vocab.sentence: To become a better cook, Julie insisted on practicing her knife skills every day.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 為了成為更好的廚師，Julie 堅持每天練習刀工。

vocab.sentence: After months of hard work, Daniel achieved his goal of getting one hundred thousand fans on YouTube.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 經過數個月的努力，Daniel 達成了在 YouTube 上擁有十萬名粉絲的目標。

vocab.sentence: I didn't eat much for lunch, so I feel particularly hungry now.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我午餐吃得不多，所以現在覺得特別餓。

vocab.sentence: Rebecca puts the frozen meat in warm water, so she can cook it for lunch later.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Rebecca 把冷凍肉放進溫水裡，這樣待會就能把它煮來當午餐。

vocab.sentence: The color green is a mix of blue and yellow.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 綠色是藍色和黃色的混合。

vocab.sentence: Gary loves the strong flavor of blue cheese.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Gary 喜歡藍紋起司的濃郁味道。

vocab.sentence: Ariel is so busy that she hasn't visited her parents for a long period of time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Ariel 忙得已經很長一段時間沒去探望父母了。

vocab.sentence: The ding-dong sound from Mandy's smartphone represents an incoming LINE message.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Mandy 的智慧型手機發出叮咚聲，表示有一則 LINE 訊息傳進來。

vocab.sentence: We had an enjoyable picnic with delicious food and music.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們享受了一次有美食和音樂的愉快野餐。

vocab.sentence: Tom is willing to do anything to promote his new product.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Tom 願意做任何事來推廣他的新產品。

vocab.sentence: My grandparents are glad to embrace new technology although it takes time to learn.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我的祖父母很樂意接受新科技，雖然學習需要花時間。

vocab.sentence: I walk down a path between the two houses to get to my school every day.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我每天沿著兩棟房屋之間的小徑走去學校。

phrases.sentence: Judy and Roy have a lot in common. For example, they both love sushi and ramen.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Judy 和 Roy 有很多共通點，例如他們都喜歡壽司和拉麵。

phrases.sentence: We had a problem with our science project, but Alisa came up with a smart solution.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們的科學專題遇到了問題，但 Alisa 想出了一個聰明的解決辦法。

phrases.sentence: Tyler was tired of his room, so he decided to redecorate it.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Tyler 厭倦了自己的房間，因此決定重新裝潢。

phrases.sentence: The delay in the building project was due to the snowstorm.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 這項建築工程因暴風雪而延誤。

phrases.sentence: Nowadays, an MP3 player is thought to be behind the times.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 如今，MP3 播放器被認為已經過時了。

phrases.sentence: The restaurant went out of business because fewer and fewer customers chose to eat there.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 這家餐廳歇業了，因為選擇去那裡用餐的顧客越來越少。

grammar.sentence: One is amusing, another is useful, and the other is strange.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一個很有趣，另一個很實用，最後一個很奇怪。

grammar.sentence: Do you know where the new display is?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你知道新的展示品在哪裡嗎？

grammar.sentence: One path is short, and the other path is long.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一條小徑很短，另一條小徑很長。

grammar.sentence: Please tell me how we can achieve our goal.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我我們可以如何達成目標。

grammar.sentence: One gathers pencils, another cleans, and the other carries bags.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一個人收拾鉛筆，另一個人打掃，最後一個人提袋子。

grammar.sentence: I wonder why the restaurant went out of business.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我想知道那家餐廳為什麼歇業。

grammar.sentence: One box is blue; another is green; the other is red.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一個箱子是藍色，另一個是綠色，最後一個是紅色。

grammar.sentence: Can you tell me whose idea this is?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你能告訴我這是誰的主意嗎？

grammar.sentence: One is willing to help, but the other is tired.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一個人願意幫忙，但另一個人累了。

grammar.sentence: Tell me what the artist will display tomorrow.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 告訴我那位藝術家明天會展示什麼。

grammar.sentence: One represents hope, another represents love, and the other represents peace.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一個代表希望，另一個代表愛，最後一個代表和平。

grammar.sentence: I know why she insists on practicing every day.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我知道她為什麼堅持每天練習。

grammar.sentence: One has wheels, another has wings, and the other has legs.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一個有輪子，另一個有翅膀，最後一個有腳。

grammar.sentence: Please tell me where we should gather after lunch.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我午餐後我們應該在哪裡集合。

grammar.sentence: One flavor is sweet, and the other flavor is sour.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一種口味是甜的，另一種口味是酸的。

grammar.sentence: Do you remember when they did the research?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你記得他們是什麼時候做那項研究的嗎？

grammar.sentence: One student reads, another writes, and the other listens.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一名學生閱讀，另一名學生寫字，最後一名學生聆聽。

grammar.sentence: I wonder what they have in common.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我想知道他們有什麼共通點。

grammar.sentence: One is frozen, another is hot, and the other is warm.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一個是冷凍的，另一個是熱的，最後一個是溫的。

grammar.sentence: Tell me who came up with this amusing game.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 告訴我是誰想出這個有趣的遊戲。

grammar.sentence: Do you know why he didn't embrace the change?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你知道他為什麼沒有接受這項改變嗎？

grammar.sentence: She wonders where this narrow path goes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她想知道這條狹窄的小徑通往哪裡。

grammar.sentence: Can you tell me what you were doing?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你能告訴我你當時在做什麼嗎？

grammar.sentence: I wonder which flavor the little boy likes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我想知道那個小男孩喜歡哪一種口味。

grammar.sentence: Please tell me whose pencil you borrowed.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我你借了誰的鉛筆。

grammar.sentence: Do you know why this machine doesn't work?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你知道這台機器為什麼不能運作嗎？

grammar.sentence: Tell me how we can make the trip enjoyable.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 告訴我我們可以如何讓這趟旅行變得愉快。

grammar.sentence: I wonder why that organization needs our help.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我想知道那個組織為什麼需要我們的幫助。

grammar.sentence: Please tell me how long the meeting lasted.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我那場會議持續了多久。

grammar.sentence: Do you know who left the door open?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你知道是誰讓門開著嗎？

cloze_quiz.question: The test was a complete ___: the machine never started, and none of its parts worked.
cloze_quiz.hint: never started 和 none of its parts worked 說明測試完全失敗，因此用 failure。goal 是想達成的目標，不能表示這次已失敗的測試結果。

cloze_quiz.question: The cartoon was so ___ that the children kept laughing at its funny characters.
cloze_quiz.hint: kept laughing 和 funny characters 表示卡通逗得孩子一直笑，所以用 amusing。willing 指人願意做某事，不是故事有趣。

cloze_quiz.question: Please ___ the scattered pencils from the floor into one pile before putting them in the box.
cloze_quiz.hint: scattered pencils 和 into one pile 要求把散落的鉛筆收集成一堆，所以用 gather。erase 是擦除內容，不能把鉛筆本身擦成一堆。

cloze_quiz.question: This ___ has a leader, thirty members, and an office. Its members work together to help children.
cloze_quiz.hint: leader、members、office，以及成員一起幫助孩子，都指向 organization「組織」。path 是小徑，不會有領導人和成員。

cloze_quiz.question: The scientists are doing ___ to find out whether the new medicine works. They test it and record the results.
cloze_quiz.hint: test it、record the results 和 find out whether 說明科學家正在進行研究，用 research。failure 是失敗，不能用 doing failure 表示測試與記錄的活動。

cloze_quiz.question: The museum will ___ the phones behind clear glass so everyone can see them. They must stay in good condition and are not for sale.
cloze_quiz.hint: so everyone can see them 表示要展示，用 display。hide 與讓大家看見衝突；not for sale 排除 sell；must stay in good condition 排除 destroy。

cloze_quiz.question: Although we asked Ben to stop, he continued to ___ on paying for all our meals.
cloze_quiz.hint: asked Ben to stop 卻 continued，表示 Ben 仍堅持；insist on + V-ing 是自然搭配。represent 不能接 on paying 表示堅持付款。

cloze_quiz.question: Lily hopes to swim across the pool without stopping. This is her ___, and she practices every day to reach it.
cloze_quiz.hint: hopes to 和 practices every day to reach it 說明那是 Lily 想達成的目標，用 goal。period 是時間長度，不是她想完成的游泳任務。

cloze_quiz.question: I love all three flavors, but I ___ like the chocolate one. It is my clear favorite.
cloze_quiz.hint: clear favorite 表示巧克力是明確最喜歡的口味，用 particularly「特別」。equally 表示同等喜歡，不能表達前句 but 引出的偏好；never／hardly 也與最喜歡矛盾。

cloze_quiz.question: The meat is still ___: it is hard with ice and has not started to melt.
cloze_quiz.hint: hard with ice 和 has not started to melt 表示肉仍結著冰，用 frozen。hot、boiling、warm 都不是題幹描述的冷凍狀態。

cloze_quiz.question: This purple paint is a ___ of red and blue. I poured the two colors into one cup and stirred them together.
cloze_quiz.hint: poured the two colors into one cup 和 stirred them together 表示把兩種顏色混合，所以用 mix。period 是時間，不是混合後的顏料。

cloze_quiz.question: The word "lemon" on the candy bag tells you its ___, or how it tastes.
cloze_quiz.hint: or how it tastes 直接說明空格指味道，所以用 flavor。color 描述外觀顏色，不能等於 how it tastes。

cloze_quiz.question: The school was closed for a ___ of two weeks while workers repaired the roof.
cloze_quiz.hint: of two weeks 指一段兩週的時間，使用 a period of two weeks。path 是道路，不能用來表示停課的時間長度。

cloze_quiz.question: On this map, the small blue circles ___ lakes. Each circle stands for one lake.
cloze_quiz.hint: stands for one lake 說明圓圈是湖泊的符號，因此用 represent。freeze 指使結冰，地圖符號不會使湖泊結冰。

cloze_quiz.question: The picnic was ___: we all had a wonderful time and wanted to do it again.
cloze_quiz.hint: had a wonderful time 和 wanted to do it again 表示大家覺得這次野餐令人愉快，所以用 enjoyable。boring 與大家度過美好時光的敘述不合。

cloze_quiz.question: Nina is ___ to help: she freely says yes and is happy to do it.
cloze_quiz.hint: freely says yes 和 happy to do it 表示 Nina 自願且樂意幫忙，用 willing。forced 是被迫，與 freely 矛盾；unwilling 和 reluctant 也不合她樂意答應的態度。

cloze_quiz.question: To ___ the new plan means to accept it gladly instead of rejecting it.
cloze_quiz.hint: accept it gladly 表示欣然接受，因此用 embrace。refuse 是拒絕，正好與題幹 instead of rejecting it 相反；forget 和 draw 都沒有接受的意思。

cloze_quiz.question: We followed a narrow dirt ___ through the forest. It was just wide enough for one person to walk along.
cloze_quiz.hint: through the forest、wide enough 和 walk along 說明這是可供行走的小徑，用 path。goal 是目標，不能描述成一條有寬度的泥土通道。
